name: Fujibayashi Shinobu
source:
A girl who accidentally collided with Yoshiyuki and kissed with him. Such event itself didn't bode any ill intent, but this girl turned out to be shinobi who lives in accordance with her village's strict laws. And those laws say: "If you kiss, you should marry!".

This is a secret character.
